properties.name: airplay.server-name
properties.description: mDNS / AirPlay display name advertised by the receiver.

properties.name: airplay.hls-enabled
properties.description: Advertise Video / HTTP-Live feature bits and accept HLS /play.

properties.name: airplay.mdns-loopback
properties.description: Include loopback in mDNS advertise/browse (self-cast / CI). Default off for release.

properties.name: airplay.tray-enabled
properties.description: Show the system tray menu (cast picker + quit).

properties.description: Cast video source installed for MirrorCaster / VideoClient.

properties.description: Cast audio source installed for MirrorCaster / AudioClient.

properties.description: Record an AirPlay dump session beside the selected player.

properties.description: Dump RTSP/HTTP control request and response captures.

properties.description: Dump HLS playlist URI and fetched m3u8 when available.

properties.name: dump.artwork
properties.description: Dump album artwork and DMAP metadata from SET_PARAMETER when present.

properties.name: dump.videoFps
properties.description: Assumed AirPlay mirror frame rate used when remuxing dumped H.264 into MP4.
